about_the_game:
IMPORTANT NOTE - YOU DO NOT NEED TO PURCHASE THIS DLC IF YOU ALREADY OWN THE FROSTMARCH EXPANSION FOR TALISMAN: DIGITAL CLASSIC EDITION. SIMPLY SIGN INTO YOUR NOMAD ACCOUNT IN BOTH GAMES AND IT WILL UNLOCK FOR YOU IN-GAME.

A cold wind blows over the land, as the Ice Queen returns! Experience this classic expansion with all-new art, updated cards and much more in Talisman: Digital 5th Edition.

The Frostmarch - Remastered!

Originally released for Talisman: 4th Edition in 2009, The Frostmarch Expansion turns the realm of Talisman into a desolate, icy wasteland where players must battle against new enemies, and the Ice Queen herself!

In Talisman: The Frostmarch Classic for Talisman: Digital 5th Edition, we’ve taken this iconic expansion and updated it from the ground-up to fit within the new 5th Edition ruleset and style. With fresh new artwork, updated card rules and new cards to use in the Deck Editor, there’s something here for new and veteran Talisman players alike!

What’s in The Frostmarch Expansion?

A Frozen Realm

Deadly beasts and fearsome monsters have emerged in this new frozen land, ready to take advantage of the magical winter sweeping the world. With new spells, encounters and cards that bring home the harsh, frozen landscape players must fight through, this expansion brings a whole new flavor of adventure to each game of Talisman.

New Adventurers

The Frostmarch Classic brings 4 new characters to the Talisman: Digital 5th Edition roster:

  • The Leprechaun, is looking to make his fortune again in 5th Edition, able to teleport around the land when his luck is on his side!

  • The Necromancer, Skilled in the arts of magic, the Necromancer has the ability to gain Spirits as Followers.

  • The Warlock, The Warlock can earn a great deal from completing Warlock Quests. Whilst others find themselves battling to survive, he’s able to gain rewards through his own quests!

  • The Ogre Chieftain, The Ice Queen has brought strong monsters with her, drawing the attention of the Ogre Chieftain - never backing down from a challenge, he’s looking to conscript his foes into his own personal army.

New Warlock Quests

With 24 Warlock Quests being added with The Frostmarch Classic and the ability to adjust the number of each Warlock Quest cards available thanks to the Deck Editor, can add even more customisation to your next Talisman session!

New Cards and 3 New Endings

Look forward to seeing your favourite Frostmarch cards lovingly remade in the 5th Edition style, with over 84 iconic adventure cards and 20 new spell cards included in The Frostmarch Classic.

Alongside these additions, The Frostmarch Classic also includes 3 new endings: Crown and Sceptre, Warlock Quests and Ice Queen for you to experience!
